verdict.rationale: vLLM's CLI docs confirm a server-start command (vllm serve) and general support for GPU/hardware configuration and quantization, and the docs mention CLI benchmarking flags, but the evidence pack never explicitly shows the specific CLI flags for GPU memory offload (e.g., --gpu-memory-utilization) or context length (--max-model-len) being set at launch. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of --gpu-memory-utilization and --max-model-len flags in a load command, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these specific flags working as described.
